jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6) inventory: the Harwood Unified Union School District is its own supervisory district (member towns Duxbury, Fayston, Moretown, Waitsfield, Warren, Waterbury).
Harwood Unified Union School District (official district website).

sources.note: Harwood Unified Union articles of agreement (revised October 24, 2018), art. 7: the board 'shall be composed of fourteen individuals elected by Australian ballot by the voters of the municipalities in which they reside' -- Duxbury 2, Fayston 2, Moretown 2, Waitsfield 2, Warren 2, Waterbury 4, with weighted votes for proportionality (the section 730(a)(1) proportional model; art. 8 sets 3-year terms). NOTE: the district's 2016 draft articles (13 seats, Waterbury 3) are SUPERSEDED -- do not use.

Harwood Unified Union board page (official): 14 members with towns and term expirations -- Duxbury: Cindy Senning (Vice Chair, 2029), Emily Dolloff (2028); Fayston: Karl Naden (2027), Langford Davidson (2028); Moretown: Steve Rosenberg (Chair, 2027), Caitlin Lovegrove (2027); Waitsfield: John Weir (2029), Alexina Cather (2027); Warren: Ashley Woods (2028), Macon Phillips (2027); Waterbury: Pamela Eaton (2029), Robert Dabrowski (2028), Theo Hanna (2027), Jillan Sackett (2027). (The page prints 'Jillan Sackett'; news uses 'J.B. Weir' for John Weir.) The district's minutes archive is JavaScript-rendered and was not fetchable: the 2025-26 appointment outcomes rest on the district's own vacancy notices + this roster, which places each person in exactly the seat and expiration the reported outcome produces.

Jillan Sackett holds the Waterbury seat Corey Hackett resigned in March 2026 (district vacancy advertised March 20, 2026) as an appointee until Town Meeting Day March 2027 -- the district's notice + the official roster; the appointment minutes were not fetchable. (Spelling as the district page prints it.)
Mike Bishop (Fayston) resigned in fall 2025; the district's Fayston vacancy notice (Oct. 2025, republished by the Town of Fayston) advertised his seat. Ended 2025.

Rebecca Baruzzi (Fayston; elected March 2025 to a term ending 2028) resigned in December 2025; the district's second Fayston vacancy notice (Dec. 2025) advertised the seat, which stayed open until the March 2026 election. Ended 2025.

Jonathan Young (Warren) resigned in January 2026; the district's Warren vacancy notice advertised his seat. Macon Phillips was appointed Feb. 11, 2026 and then elected March 3, 2026 to the remaining year. Ended 2026.
Ben Clark's Moretown term ended at the March 3, 2026 election and he did not seek re-election; no candidate filed, and the seat was filled by appointment (Lovegrove). Ended 2026.
Dan Roscioli was appointed in 2025 to a 1-year unexpired Waterbury term and did not run in March 2026; his seat passed to Theo Hanna at that election. Ended 2026.

Corey Hackett (Waterbury; elected March 2025 to the remaining two years of a term ending 2027) resigned in March 2026; the district advertised the vacancy March 20, 2026 and Jillan Sackett now holds the seat as an appointee. Ended 2026.
Bobbi Rood (Waitsfield) resigned effective August 27, 2026 (district vacancy notice, Aug. 28, 2026); Alexina Cather was appointed to the seat. Ended 2026.
